total_model.summary: Model projects 43.5 total points (CAR 19, DEN 24). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 1.7), Combined rush defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 0.7), Natural grass field (lowers total 0.6). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
